svg.title: Known-best packing of 204 unit squares
svg.desc: The retained known-best n=204 construction, normalized to Witness/v2 and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer.

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete 12fc466 rational centre/half-angle certificate in Evan Daniel's format, centres in [0, S]^2, converted from a checkout at the pin whose bytes have the digests the packet records; no upstream byte is retained. Finite construction feasibility only; no KKT, local minimum, rigidity, novelty, priority or global optimality claim.

svg.text: U n=204 known best: side ~ 14.80864283 (certified upper bound)
